_comment: Reel first-second hooks. Each Reel references one hook id so the experiment tracker can compare them.

H01.name: Tactile ignition
H01.first_second: Extreme close-up of a glove, helmet or ignition with a sharp sound.

H02.name: Walk-past
H02.first_second: He is already moving toward or away from the lens; no eye contact.

H03.name: Hand enters frame
H03.first_second: Still frame; a second hand (hers) enters within 1s.

H04.name: Screen lock
H04.first_second: Phone lights up with an unreadable message.

H05.name: Doors
H05.first_second: Elevator or hotel door opening or closing.

H06.name: The look
H06.first_second: Light or head-turn that ends on a direct stare.

H07.name: Wet glass POV
H07.first_second: Rain, windscreen or window with city light streaks.

H09.name: Place cut
H09.first_second: Match-cut into a new unexplained location.

H10.name: Morning texture
H10.first_second: Kettle, curtains, water: everyday sound-first opener.

H12.name: Composure breaks
H12.first_second: He is stern, then laughs because of someone off-camera.
